snippet.title: The Man Who Moved a Prickly Branch 🌿 True Story for Kids | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
What tiny thing made Allah very, very happy?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) told us about a man who was walking along a path. He found a thorny branch lying in the way, so he picked it up and moved it out of the way. Allah was happy with what he did, and forgave him!

So if your little one sees a stone on the path or a toy on the stairs, move it away. What will you move out of the way today?

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 652: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:652
